records.issue_text: `app/views/embed/loading.html.erb:9` reloads every 30s unconditionally with no attempt cap, so permanently failing retrieval makes every visitor's iframe poll the forum forever
records.rationale: loading.html.erb adds an unconditional setTimeout reload every 30s with no cap or backoff. When the enqueued RetrieveTopic job fails (e.g. invalid host, missing user in TopicRetriever#fetch_http returns silently, or feed polling never matches the URL), TopicEmbed.topic_id_for_embed stays nil forever and every visitor's iframe keeps hitting /embed/best indefinitely. The mechanism is verifiable in the diff: the loading view is rendered whenever topic_id is nil, and the retrieval path has several silent no-op exits.
